concerns.message: decisions.md assumes the existing resolveRevealInputs tests already prove acceptance item 3 (an explicit non-empty justification wins over the stored one). They don't. The only params-vs-stored case, `should use params justification over empty storage justification` (resolveRevealInputs.test.ts:71-84), stores `justification: undefined`. The two `justification handling` cases (lines 279-321) have no stored record. No test has a non-empty stored justification together with a non-empty param. Item 2 (no stored record) is covered, but split across several tests.
concerns.consequence: If the worker follows decisions.md and adds only the two listed tests, acceptance item 3 has no test behind it, and the review sends the lane back for rework. The worker should add one more case to resolveRevealInputs.test.ts: stored `{ salt, choice, justification: "stored text" }` plus param `justification: "param text"` resolves to "param text". It is inside the owned paths and costs nothing.

concerns.message: The planned mocks for the component test (useRevealVote, the dispute queries, useParams, i18n) leave out `src/dispute-kits`. `Reveal.tsx:16` imports `DisputeKits` from the `src/dispute-kits` index, which re-exports `./registry`. The registry imports `hooks/contracts/generated` (codegen output) plus every Voting and Appeal page component, which bring in wagmi, the Shutter SDK through the commit builders, and SVG imports. `web/vitest.config.ts` has no svgr plugin. The comment at `src/dispute-kits/index.ts:1-2` warns about exactly this. `Button` from `@kleros/ui-components-library` also needs the theme, and jsdom may not support it.
concerns.consequence: The first `.test.tsx` in the repo could fail at import time or at render for reasons unrelated to the fix. The worker then burns much of the sixty-minute budget or reports `blocked`. To avoid it, the test should also mock `src/dispute-kits` (returning only `DisputeKits`) and `@kleros/ui-components-library` (a plain `<button onClick>`).

concerns.message: The 'must fail on current code' assertion needs care. If the worker writes `justification: undefined` explicitly instead of leaving the key out, `not.toHaveProperty('justification')` would fail on the fixed code, and a loosely written assertion could also pass on the current code. The test should assert on the actual value, e.g. `expect(call.params.justification).toBeUndefined()`, and the worker should check once that it fails with the `""` state still in place. Also remove `justification` from the `useCallback` deps array, or `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` / `noUnusedLocals` will fail `check-style` / `check-types`.
concerns.consequence: Otherwise the regression test is either brittle or doesn't actually prove the regression, or the lint/type checks fail on a leftover identifier.

structured_output.simpler_alternative: Make the one-line change in `Shutter/Reveal.tsx`: drop the `justification` state, its eslint-disable comment and both TODOs, and leave the key out of the `revealVote` params. Then prove it only at the `resolveRevealInputs` level. Add two cases: the exact Reveal params with no justification plus stored "stored text" resolves to "stored text"; an explicit "param text" plus stored "stored text" resolves to "param text". Skip the component test. It is the only costly and fragile part (first `.test.tsx`, heavy import chain), and it guards against one literal being reintroduced, which type-checking and review already catch. If the operator wants to keep it, it must mock `src/dispute-kits` and the UI `Button` as well as the listed modules.
structured_output.cheap_experiment: Before writing any assertions, create a stub `web/src/pages/Cases/CaseDetails/Voting/Shutter/Reveal.test.tsx`. It should apply only the four planned `vi.mock`s (hooks/useRevealVote, queries/useDisputeDetailsQuery, queries/usePopulatedDisputeData, react-router-dom useParams, react-i18next), `render(<Reveal voteIDs={["0"]} setIsOpen={vi.fn()} disputeKitId={DisputeKits.Shutter} />)` and click the button. Run `yarn workspace @kleros/kleros-v2-web vitest run src/pages/Cases/CaseDetails/Voting/Shutter/Reveal.test.tsx`. If it fails loading the registry, the generated contracts, the Shutter SDK or the UI library, add mocks for `src/dispute-kits` and `@kleros/ui-components-library`. If it still can't render in about 10 minutes, switch to the simpler alternative (helper-level tests only).
